mapper.select: SELECT count(1) FROM ods_user_ltv_record_diversion oulrd INNER JOIN dim_user_info dui on (oulrd.user_id = dui.user_id) WHERE oulrd.`type` = 2 and oulrd.dates = #{dates}

SELECT dulr.id, oulrd.dates, dui.user_id, dui.last_version `version`, dui.pkg, dui.country, oulrd.`type`, oulrd.ltv, IFNULL(dulr.create_time, now()) FROM ods_user_ltv_record_diversion oulrd INNER JOIN dim_user_info dui on (oulrd.user_id = dui.user_id) LEFT JOIN dwd_user_ltv_record dulr on (dulr.dates = oulrd.dates and dulr.user_id = oulrd.user_id and dulr.pkg = dui.pkg and dulr.country = dui.country) WHERE oulrd.`type` = 2 and oulrd.dates = #{dates} limit #{startRows}, #{rows}
